entries.zh: 轮；圆轮；此处兼指轮节状的关节（西语词头应为 coyuntura）
entries.en: wheel; round disc; joint of the body (coyuntura)
entries.notes: 词头 Cointura 判断为 coyuntura（关节）的拼写变体（y/i 相混），单字 轮 义偏窄，降中置信

entries.zh: 节；骨节、关节；亦指竹节、段落
entries.en: joint (of the body); node; bamboo segment

entries.zh: 骨轮；骨节，骨头相接处的关节
entries.en: bone joint; articulation of bones

entries.zh: 手节；手指关节
entries.en: joint of the finger; finger knuckle

entries.zh: 手目；手掌、手腕处的骨节（掌节）
entries.en: joint of the hand; knuckle or wrist

entries.zh: 根节；根株相连之节，亦指筋脉根部之结
entries.en: root joint; node where root meets stalk (or root of a sinew)
entries.notes: 西语 de la Vena（筋脉）与汉字 根节 语义未尽吻合，释义以汉字为主

entries.zh: 骨节；一骨嵌入另一骨内的关节
entries.en: bone joint; articulation (one bone set into another)

entries.zh: 熬；长时间煮炖（如连骨熬汤）
entries.en: to stew; to simmer long (as with bones)

entries.zh: 炊（一说爨）；烧火做饭，蒸煮熟食
entries.en: to cook food; to steam rice (variant 爨, same sense)

entries.zh: 煮；烧煮食物或水
entries.en: to boil; to cook (food or water)

entries.zh: 煠；将食物放入沸水或热油中急煮（字或作燥，存疑）
entries.en: to scald or briefly fry in boiling water or oil (character uncertain: 煠/燥)
entries.notes: 汉字存疑[煠/燥]，M 音写 să 支持煠字急煮义；R 对音 fă chîn 未能坐实

entries.zh: 熟；煮透、烧熟
entries.en: cooked through; to cook thoroughly
entries.notes: M 栏声调符号污损（T99），释义据汉字 熟 与西语 cocer bien cocido 推定

entries.zh: 陶；烧制陶器、烧窑成陶
entries.en: to fire pottery; to bake ceramics
entries.notes: M 栏 Fō/Tō 与 R 栏 tōn/tāu 双存疑，释义依汉字 陶 与西语 cocer loza 推定

entries.zh: 炊；隔水蒸煮，食物不直接沾水
entries.en: to steam (cook above water, food not touching it)

entries.zh: 蒸米饭；用少量水把米蒸熟
entries.en: to steam rice (with little water)

entries.zh: 白焯（白煠）；只用清水煮，不调味焯烫
entries.en: to blanch in plain water (second character uncertain: 煠/燥)
entries.notes: 第二字存疑[煠/燥]；M 音写 pè sá 与白煠读相合，R 对音 pē chîn 未解

entries.zh: 炊爨；烧饭做菜，操持烹煮
entries.en: to do the cooking; to cook (any food)
entries.notes: M 首字声调符号污损（T99），释义据汉字 炊爨 与西语 cocer qualquiera cosa 推定

entries.zh: 煮烂；煮至酥软即化
entries.en: to boil until soft; to cook to a pulp

entries.zh: 熬膏药；煎熬药膏
entries.en: to decoct an ointment; to prepare a medicinal plaster

entries.zh: 灶；烧饭的炉灶，引申指厨房
entries.en: kitchen stove; hearth; kitchen
